authority_invariant: PentaCensus may discover, count, classify, diff and route Penta namespace evidence. Discovery, documentation, taxonomy placement, confidence or repeated observation never create canonical identity, execution eligibility, credentials, provider permission, certification, production status, financial or rights authority, or D3/human-reserved authority.

systems.purpose: Continuously census the governed CrownThrive Penta namespace, detect previously unseen institutional Penta identity declarations, preserve advisory Penta-named references for semantic/topology review, and route unresolved discoveries into fail-closed canonicalization and documentation lanes.
systems.human_surface: Penta census summaries, namespace drift findings, discovery evidence, semantic-review queues and reconciliation receipts
systems.authority_boundary: Read/discovery/classification only. It cannot self-register a new canonical Penta, promote maturity, grant execution eligibility, write provider state, use credentials, move money, alter rights, merge/release code, certify itself, or perform D3/human-reserved decisions.

five_stage.discover: Scan governed source classes for object-scoped institutional identity declarations and advisory Penta-named references, binding every observation to source-path evidence.
five_stage.govern: Compare declarations to canonical registry, governed extensions, aliases and candidate namespace records without promoting unresolved discoveries; route ambiguous references to semantic/topology review.
five_stage.execute: Produce deterministic census and drift results and route unknown institutional identities to PentaScribe/PentaPology/PentaDocs canonicalization lanes.
five_stage.verify: Require deterministic replay, namespace-count consistency, exact-source evidence and independent PentaAssure/PentaCertify evidence before any maturity promotion.
five_stage.preserve: Retain namespace lineage and candidate/reference dispositions so renames, aliases, supersessions and historical references are not erased.

production_promotion_requirements: strict object-scoped identity declaration census is clean
Penta Portal Docs regeneration is converged
